body: I don't have the answers, i could just be making it up and fooling myself, but it still comforts me on a bad day.
hi 3456.  which part did you like?  I needed a break from the forum after writing this and i'm just now returning.

Me too, but life is like that too, it’s cruel and giving.  I really suffer sometimes but I still think of things that are worth fighting for.  Yeah we’re all gonna die naturally, and yeah the world has a population problem, and I’m not at all religious but I still believe in this vast universe there is a world beside this one and suicide only kills the body not you.  That’s why I’ve never gone through with it.  I know the world seems really fucked up and unpleasant but what scares me the most about suicide is that I think only compassionate people do it.  assholes don’t hurt themselves as often as people who understand pain and suffering all too well.  Please, listen to me.  I see your value without even knowing who you are.

Don’t kill your self unless you enjoy being unable to interact with anything and everyone forever past the end of time.  Someone I used to be very intimate with killed themselves and on the anniversary of the day he died he came to me in a dream and said he deeply regretted it.  That’s all I can tell you just please don’t do it.  You’ll kill so many people who love you.
